caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which appears to be an old or handmade farming or gardening tool rendered in shades of brown and rust-like colors. Attached to this handle is a flat, rectangular metal base with a central pivot or bolt connecting the parts. Extending downward and outward from this base are four irregular, twisted metal tines or prongs, with two more prominent ones in the center and two on either side, all showing a somewhat rough and bent appearance.
